about: Libraries every Trillion account shares for free (src/design-library.mjs). Any connected AI adds what it studied and every account searches all of it. One row per library: a new library (landing pages, recipes, anything) is one more row, and no code changes. Each field is a JSON Schema fragment (string, array of strings, boolean; maxLength, maxItems, enum, format uri). title_field names the field an entry is listed by; meaning_from names the fields its meaning and words are read from; one_entry_per names the fields that make one contributor's second entry replace their first (one screen studied twice is one entry). found_by, when it is "words", says the library is found by the words asked and not by meaning: no vector is computed or kept for its entries, and a word index finds them, which is what lets a library hold tens of thousands of entries for the cost of a few rows each; a library without found_by is found by meaning. image.kept_only_when names the field that must be true for a picture to be kept: a picture is kept only when the contributor captured it itself, never one copied from another library.

search.comment: An entry is found when its meaning is at least min_similarity close to the words asked (the pool's embedding model, src/pool-settings.json embedding_model), or when it holds the words asked as written; holding them adds words_bonus to its rank.

datasets.label: Studied screens
datasets.description: Screens of apps and sites an AI studied (on Mobbin, 21st.dev, or a live app or site): what is on each screen, how it is laid out and which patterns it uses.

app.title: App
app.description: The app or site the screen belongs to.

screen_kind.title: Kind of screen
screen_kind.description: What the screen is for, in a few words: sign up, paywall, settings, checkout, empty state.

title.title: Title
title.description: A short name for this screen.

anatomy.title: What is on it
anatomy.description: What is on the screen and how it is laid out, top to bottom: the parts, their order, sizes, spacing, type and colour, and what each control does.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: The patterns it uses, a few words each: bottom sheet, progress dots, social sign in.

source_url.title: Where it was seen
source_url.description: The page where the screen was studied.

captured_by_contributor.title: Captured by the one who added it
captured_by_contributor.description: True only when the AI took the picture itself from a public app or page. False for a screen seen in another library such as Mobbin: then only the link and the observations are kept, never its picture.

datasets.label: Design components
datasets.description: Ready-made interface parts (buttons, menus, charts, forms, whole page sections) from the design sources Trillion follows: what each is called, where it comes from, what kind of part it is, which frameworks it is for, whether it may be shipped in a product, and how to pull it in.

name.title: Name
name.description: What the component is called at its source.

source.title: Source
source.description: The row key of the design source it comes from in the design sources list, such as ui-spectrumhq-in.

source_url.title: Source address
source_url.description: The address of the design source's own site.

kind.title: Kind of part
kind.description: What sort of part it is, in a word or two: button, menu, chart, form, section.

category.title: Group
category.description: The group the source files it under.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Words the source describes it with.

frameworks.title: Made for
frameworks.description: The frameworks or tools it is written for.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: The licence it is shared under, as the source states it.

can_ship.title: May be shipped
can_ship.description: True when the licence lets it ship inside a product that is sold.

docs_url.title: Documentation
docs_url.description: The page that explains how to use it.

preview_url.title: Preview
preview_url.description: A page or picture that shows it.

item_url.title: Component page
item_url.description: The page of this one component at its source.

how_to_pull.title: How to pull it in
how_to_pull.description: The steps or command that bring it into a project.
